channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye says taking precautions amid Iran-US tensions
item.description: Defense authorities said on Feb. 26 that Türkiye is taking necessary precautions amid escalating tensions between Iran and the United States.

item.title: Galatasaray eliminate Juventus in Champions League
item.description: Galatasaray scraped through to the last 16 of the Champions League despite throwing away a three-goal aggregate lead at 10-man Juventus on Wednesday, with two extra-time goals limiting the Turkish outfit to a 3-2 defeat.

item.title: Heavy snowfall shuts schools in several provinces across Türkiye
item.description: Amid heavy snow, treacherous icy roads and deteriorating conditions, authorities in multiple Turkish provinces have declared a one-day suspension of in-person classes on Feb. 26, while meteorologists predict persistent difficult winter weather in eastern regions and spreading cold to the west.

item.title: Court imposes house arrest on teen accused of year-long peer bullying
item.description: A 15-year-old boy in Istanbul has been placed under house arrest outside school hours and ordered to wear an electronic monitoring bracelet after allegedly assaulting and chasing a classmate with a knife in what authorities describe as a prolonged case of peer bullying.

item.title: IMF warns US of risks from tariffs and rising debt
item.description: A “buoyant'' U.S. economy is poised to see accelerated growth and lower unemployment this year. But big federal budget debts ”represent a growing stability risk,'' the International Monetary Fund has said.

item.title: EBRD upgrades Turkish GDP growth outlook for 2026
item.description: In its latest outlook, the EBRD has upgraded Türkiye's economic growth projections to 4 percent for 2026 and 4.5 percent for 2027, citing the success of the nation's macroeconomic stabilization efforts in supporting growth while curbing inflation.

item.title: Öcalan to make a new statement for boosting 'terror-free Türkiye' bid
item.description: Jailed PKK leader Abdullah Öcalan is set to release a new statement on Feb. 27, a year after his first and historic call, to mark the importance of running the terror-free Türkiye project with calls on PKK brass on what needs to be done in the next stages.

item.title: Kiev locals pool together for solar panels, batteries
item.description: When Russian strikes cut off the power, heating and water to swathes of the Ukrainian capital in minus 20 degrees Celsius temperatures, Denys Biletsky was prepared.

item.title: Erdoğan lashes out at Israel for continued attacks on Gaza
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has said Israel is continuing its fatal attacks on the Palestinians in Gaza despite the ceasefire and efforts to intensify works for the reconstruction of the enclave.

item.title: Iran submits draft proposal to US as nuclear talks take place in Geneva
item.description: Iran has presented a proposal to the United States that is expected to serve as a practical test to gauge the U.S. side’s “seriousness,” media on Feb. 26 said, as Tehran and Washington held talks in Geneva.
